# The move-test setup return annotation still describes the old tuple

The setup helper now returns two folder objects and the synthetic-message array, and its prose says so. Its @returns annotation still lists two strings and two folders. The accepted source keeps this mismatch. Documentation for this helper must describe the values the callers destructure; this is a scoped contract correction, not a global tuple or naming convention.

Scope: Exchange test-helper JSDoc.
